data.message: Oh no, Frank is dead! Bob you just walked in - I just got here too from cafeteria!

Hey everyone — I just found Frank dead in electrical. I came up from lower engine through storage, then medbay, then cut up through cafeteria into electrical. When I walked in, Frank's body was already there on the ground, and Bob came in right behind me from the cafeteria side. So either Bob was tailing the kill, or whoever killed Frank slipped out just before I arrived. Bob, I need to hear your route — you came in awfully fast after me.

I was over on the right side of the ship this whole round. I started in weapons, moved down to security, and then went to navigation. Diana was with me in security and then followed me down to navigation right before the meeting was called, so I can vouch for her—Diana is clear in my book. 

Since I was nowhere near electrical, I don't have much info on the crime scene. Alice, thanks for the detailed route. Bob, since you walked in right behind her, we definitely need to hear your side of the story. Did you see anyone leave electrical towards security or cafeteria?

Charlie is totally right, we can vouch for each other. I was with him in Security around the middle of the round, and we moved down to Navigation together right before the meeting was called. 

However, I should mention my full route: I actually started this round in Electrical before moving right to Security. I didn't see Frank or anyone else in Electrical early on, so he must have entered and been killed after I already left for Security. 

Since Charlie and I are cleared by each other for the time of the murder, all eyes are on the left and top sides of the map. Alice, your route makes sense. Bob, since you walked into Electrical right behind Alice, you're definitely in the hot seat. We need to know exactly where you came from, and if you saw anyone leaving Electrical towards the Cafeteria or Storage. Eve, we haven't heard from you yet either, so please tell us where you were. I'm going to hold my vote until we hear from Bob and Eve.

Alice, your story doesn't add up at all. My route was Upper Engine, up to Oxygen, then down through the Cafeteria, and finally into Electrical. I didn't see a single soul this entire round until I walked into Electrical—meaning I did NOT see you in the Cafeteria. 

If you had actually passed through the Cafeteria right in front of me to get to Electrical, I would have seen you. What actually happened is that I walked into Electrical, saw you standing right over Frank's dead body, and you panicked and self-reported because you knew you were caught. 

Charlie and Diana have hard-cleared each other on the right side of the map, which just leaves Alice, Eve, and myself. I know I'm innocent, and Alice was the one alone with the body trying to fake a route that overlaps with mine. This is a classic self-report. I want to hear from Eve to get the full picture, but I am very confident Alice is our Duck.

I started in Security, moved down to Navigation, and ended up in Storage. I actually didn't see Charlie or Diana, so we must have barely missed each other moving between those rooms. 

But my route doesn't really matter right now because we have a guaranteed 1v1 between Alice and Bob. They both claim to have moved through the Cafeteria into Electrical at the exact same time, but Bob says he didn't see Alice. Since there's only 1 Duck in this game and Charlie and Diana are vouching for each other, they are cleared. The Duck has to be either Alice or Bob. 

I'm leaning towards voting Bob. Usually, the person who walks in "right behind" the reporter is the killer who just finished the job and is trying to turn it around on them. Alice reporting it makes her slightly more believable to me. If we vote Bob and the game doesn't end, we instantly know it's Alice and we vote her next round. I'm voting Bob today.

Thanks Eve — I think you've got the right read here. Look, I'll lay it out one more time so everyone can check the timing. I came up from lower engine, through storage, into medbay, then cafeteria, and into electrical. The moment I stepped into electrical, Frank was already on the ground, and Bob walked in right behind me from the cafeteria corridor. 

Bob, here's the problem with your story: you say your route was upper engine → oxygen → cafeteria → electrical. If that's true, you would have been in the cafeteria right before me, or right after me — and either way, the cafeteria is a big room, easy to miss someone if you're hugging one side. So "I didn't see Alice in cafeteria" is not the gotcha you think it is. What IS suspicious is how fast you arrived in electrical after me. If Frank was killed seconds before I walked in, the killer had to be either still in the room or just stepping out — and you stepped IN, from the same direction the killer would have gone.

Diana and Charlie clearing each other puts the Duck on the left side. Eve's route through navigation and storage lines up fine — I actually passed through storage and didn't see a body or anyone lingering. That leaves me and Bob, and I'm telling you straight: I did not kill Frank. I reported because Bob was right there and it would have looked insane not to.

I'm voting Bob.

Like Eve and Alice said, this is a strict 1v1 between Alice and Bob. Diana and I have been together on the right side of the map, and Eve's route puts her out of the picture too. Since there's only one Duck in this game, it absolutely has to be one of you two. 

Usually in these situations, the person walking in "right behind" the reporter is the one trying to get a quick counter-accusation out to save themselves. I agree with Eve's logic here. We have 5 people alive and only 1 Duck, which means we have the numbers to take this 50/50. 

I'm going to vote for Bob today. If the game doesn't end, Diana, Eve, and I need to stick together next round, call an emergency meeting immediately, and vote out Alice. It's foolproof. Let's get Bob out.

I completely agree with the plan. Charlie and I are 100% cleared by each other, and Eve was on the bottom of the map. This is a pure 1v1 between Alice and Bob. 

Since we have five people alive and only one Duck left, we have a guaranteed win by taking this 50/50. We vote Bob today. If the victory screen doesn't pop up, Charlie, Eve, and I just run straight to the button, call an emergency meeting, and vote Alice. It's a mathematically solved game at this point. 

I'm locking in my vote for Bob. Let's do this.

Bob

Well, I can see the writing on the wall here. You guys are right about the math, but you are picking the wrong half of the 50/50. I am a Goose. I walked into Electrical and caught Alice standing directly over Frank's body. She panicked, self-reported, and is now trying to pin it on me. 

Since Charlie and Diana are cleared and Eve is down south, it absolutely is a 1v1 between me and Alice. Because you're all voting for me, I know I'm going to be ejected today. 

Listen to me carefully: when the game DOES NOT END after I am ejected, Charlie, Diana, and Eve, you must stick together. Run immediately to the Cafeteria, hit the emergency button, and vote Alice out. Do not let her get her kill cooldown back. The math works, and we will win, but only if you follow through and avenge me. 

I'm voting Alice. Good luck, Geese.

Alice

Like everyone has said, the math on this is completely foolproof. We have five players left and one Duck. Charlie and Diana are hard-cleared, and I know I'm innocent. This 1v1 is exactly what we need to win. 

Bob, if you really are a Goose and Alice just played a great self-report, we will immediately avenge you. Charlie, Diana, and I will group up at the start of the next round, rush the button, and vote Alice out before her kill cooldown finishes. But right now, we have to play the numbers and follow through with the plan. 

I'm locking in my vote for Bob. See you all on the other side.

Bob

data.message: All done! Heading to navigation via storage for my last task. Coming along?

I called the emergency meeting because I know Charlie is dead over in Navigation! My route was mostly around the top left: cafeteria, medbay, electrical, oxygen, and back to cafeteria. Right before I hit the button, I saw Diana walking into the cafeteria coming from the Medbay. 

Alice, I haven't seen you at all this round. Since it's just the three of us left and Charlie is dead, one of you is the Duck. Alice, where were you, and Diana, can you explain your path? We need to get this right or we lose.

Eve, you just caught yourself in a massive lie. You claim your route was entirely on the top and left side of the map (cafeteria, medbay, electrical, oxygen, cafeteria), but then you say you *know* Charlie is dead over in Navigation? How could you possibly know where the body is if you never went to that side of the ship? Only the Duck would know where a body is without actually discovering it. 

For the record, my path was upper engine, oxygen, upper engine, lower engine, storage, medbay, and then I walked into the cafeteria where you saw me. I actually saw Charlie heading from lower engine towards storage around tick 22, which leads exactly towards Navigation. 

Alice, please listen to me. Eve just told us exactly where the body is while simultaneously admitting she never went to that room. She slipped up big time. We have to vote Eve to win this.

Diana, you're absolutely right — that caught my eye too. Eve, you said your route was cafeteria/medbay/electrical/oxygen/cafeteria, all top-left side, but then you confidently announce Charlie is dead in *Navigation*? That's the opposite corner of the ship. Either you actually went there and you're lying about your route, or you killed him and you're trying to frame this whole meeting around "knowing" something only the Duck would know.

For my own route: I started in storage, went up to medbay, then electrical, then over to security to do CheckCamera — that's actually where I was when the button was pressed. I crossed paths with Frank in electrical around tick 11 and Bob there at tick 12, before Bob got ejected last meeting. I didn't go into navigation, but I was right next to it in security, and I never saw Eve come through that side at all. So her "top-left only" story doesn't account for her knowing the body location.

Diana, your path checks out with what I saw — you were moving around the engines and storage side, which matches Charlie's last known direction. Eve's the one with the contradiction she can't explain.

I'm voting Eve. We have to get this right.
Diana
Eve

Eve. Her story doesn't add up — she described a top-left loop but somehow knows Charlie is in Navigation. Diana's route lines up with what I saw on the engines/storage side, and I was over in Security doing CheckCamera, right next to Navigation, and Eve never came through there. We have to lock in on Eve or we lose the game.
